ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with an estimated 80:20 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity white zones occupying approximately 80% of the surface area, separated by a central dark pigmentation column extending from the peduncle to the notch. A continuous dark pigment border follows the trailing edge and lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary with pixel amplitudes between 4 and 12 pixels, isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical curve shows convex sweep on the distal edges, tapering toward the lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, scattered dark circular clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) localized on the medial regions of both white lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Irregular, feathered pigmentation transition at the interface of the central dark column and the white ventral fields.
